title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 17 (Copies of memorandum, articles, etc., to be given to members)

content.overview: Section 17 gives a member a statutory right to obtain specified corporate documents on request, subject to prescribed fees. The company must supply the memorandum, articles, and specified section 117 agreements/resolutions within seven days; default attracts a daily penalty subject to the statutory cap.
content.glance: Member requests covered documents; company must supply them within seven days subject to prescribed fees; non-compliance attracts the section 17 penalty.
content.study: Section 17 is a document-access provision. On a member's request, the company must send within seven days, subject to prescribed fees, a copy of the memorandum, articles, and every agreement and resolution referred to in section 117(1) insofar as it has not been embodied in the memorandum or articles. A default exposes the company and every officer in default to a penalty of ₹1,000 for each day the default continues or ₹1 lakh, whichever is less. The provision should be analysed by identifying the requester, the document category, whether the document falls within section 17(1), the request date, the seven-day deadline, applicable fee and any continuing default.

sections.heading: Statutory right and scope
sections.body: Section 17(1) creates a right for a member, on request and subject to prescribed fees, to receive copies of the memorandum, articles, and specified section 117(1) agreements/resolutions not embodied in those constitutional documents.

sections.heading: Seven-day compliance period
sections.body: The company must send the requested documents within seven days of the request. The date of request and evidence of dispatch/receipt are therefore material to compliance analysis.

sections.heading: Default and penalty
sections.body: For each default, the company and every officer in default are liable to a penalty of ₹1,000 for each day the default continues or ₹1 lakh, whichever is less.

sections.heading: Application test
sections.body: Identify the member, requested document, statutory category, fee requirement, request date, seven-day deadline and duration of default before determining liability.
